tbesh_html:
1) to incite, allure, instigate, entice
1a) (Hiphil)
1a1) to incite (to a request)
1a2) to allure, lure
1a3) to instigate (bad sense)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to prick, i.e. (figuratively) stimulate; by implication, to seduce
strongs_1890.kjv_def: entice, move, persuade, provoke, remove, set on, stir up, take away.
